cases.description: Should trigger: user can only recognize what they want by seeing it
cases.input: I'm not sure what layout I want for the landing page. Show me some options.
cases.expect: Produces 3-5 wildly different disposable variations for one decision
assertions: Establishes scope first (one decision per round)
Produces 3-5 wildly different, not similar, variations
Makes them cheap and disposable (single self-contained HTML with fake data)
Labels each variation with the belief it bets on
Collects reactions and verbalizes the learned criterion

cases.description: Should trigger: unknown knowns during design exploration
cases.input: Give me a few different takes on the data model so I can react.
assertions: One-screen sketch per approach: idea, what it optimizes for, sharpest tradeoff
Does not converge early to one variation

cases.description: Not trigger: explicit spec exists, decision already made
cases.input: Implement the layout we already agreed on in the spec.
What's the difference between SQL and NoSQL?

cases.description: Should trigger: ranked lists as prototypes for decision
cases.input: Give me the three engagement ideas ranked from cheapest to most ambitious so I can draw my line.
cases.expect: Orders ranked-list variations cheapest-to-most-ambitious so the user can draw their line
assertions: Orders from cheapest to most ambitious
Labels each with the belief it bets on
